subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Ravi said to me, “Do you know the house of your family doctor?”

options.text: Ravi asked me if I knew the house of my family doctor.
Ravi asked did I know the house of our family doctor.
Ravi said to me if did I know the house of our family doctor.
Ravi told me to know the house of our family doctor.

solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "Ravi said to me, “Do you know the house of your family doctor?”" is in direct speech.
 
• In indirect speech, we remove the quotation marks and the sentence should use an appropriate conjunction to connect the reported speech. Also, the pronoun 'you' changes to 'I' from the speaker's perspective.
 
• Among the given options, option 1, "Ravi asked me if I knew the house of my family doctor." correctly transforms the direct speech into indirect speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "Ravi asked did I know the house of our family doctor." This does not follow the correct syntax for forming questions in indirect speech.
 
• Option 3: "Ravi said to me if did I know the house of our family doctor." This option maintains the syntax of direct speech, which is not correct when converting to indirect speech.
 
• Option 4: "Ravi told me to know the house of our family doctor." This sentence changes the original meaning as it sounds more like an instruction than a question.
